description: This file defines a SwiftUI View for integrating Tailscale settings into an application. It includes an enumeration for different Tailscale modes, a view structure with state management, UI components, configuration loading and saving functions, and debugging utilities.

classes.name: GatewayTailscaleMode
classes.description: An enumeration representing different Tailscale operational modes within the gateway, with associated labels and descriptions.

classes.name: TailscaleIntegrationSection
classes.description: A SwiftUI View managing Tailscale configuration and status display, including user interactions for mode selection and authentication.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads Tailscale configuration from persistent storage into view state.

methods.name: applySettings
methods.description: Validates user input and updates the Tailscale configuration file, potentially restarting the gateway.

methods.name: buildAndSaveTailscaleConfig
methods.description: Constructs configuration data based on user settings and saves it asynchronously.

methods.name: restartGatewayIfNeeded
methods.description: Restarts the gateway process if required conditions are met.

methods.name: startStatusTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer to regularly check Tailscale status.
